title: Germany news: Merz joins German-Ukrainian business forum
summary: Chancellor Merz is taking part in a forum to boost business ties with Ukraine. Meanwhile, youth protests are expected to take to the streets again. DW has the latest.

blocks.text: Finance ministry launches dialogue on economic future
Germany's finance ministry officials said the agency is launching a dialogue process, dubbed "Germany 2035," to develop proposals for the future of the country's economy.
Officials want to study how Germany can secure growth and prosperity and what that could look like in terms of fiscal-policy.
Finance Minister Lars ​Klingbeil will begin the dialogue process on December ​2, when he welcomes economists from around the world to Berlin.
Aditionally, think tanks, ​research organisations, universities and civil society groups have been asked to host workshops, which would take place in the first half of ​2027.

Among 12 economic topics that the ministry seeks to explore are tax and fiscal policy, investment ⁠and ​domestic demand, industrial policy, energy ​and climate transition, foreign trade and sovereignty, and housing ​and local infrastructure.
The dialogue will culminate with a white paper, to be published in 2028, that can provide recommendations for Germany's economic future up to 2035.
